speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. These are concerning signs of a systemic illness, possibly malignancy or infection. To narrow this down, have you had any fever, and do you have a history of smoking or recent travel? REQUEST TEST: CBC, ESR, LDH.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Complete Blood Count: WBC Elevated, Hemoglobin Slightly Decreased, Platelets Normal; Lactate Dehydrogenase: Elevated

speaker: Doctor
text: The elevated LDH and WBC with anemia are highly suspicious for a hematologic malignancy; given the supraclavicular lymphadenopathy and weight loss, have you noticed any specific skin rashes, joint pain, or bone discomfort recently? I am also ordering an LDH level check and requesting a CT scan of the chest, abdomen, and pelvis to assess the extent of lymphadenopathy and organ involvement. REQUEST TEST: LDH (confirmatory), REQUEST IMAGES: CT_Chest_Abdomen_Pelvis.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Lactate Dehydrogenase: Elevated; CT_Scan_Thorax_and_Abdomen: Findings show massively enlarged axillary, mediastinal, and cervical lymph nodes.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma (likely Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma given the massive mediastinal involvement). REQUEST IMAGES: CT_Breast if female or focused CT_Liver_Spleen if symptoms suggest hepatic involvement; please also proceed with biopsy of the most accessible enlarged node for definitive histopathology.
